description: Independent. By design. (Official political campaign T-shirt of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) Change doesn’t come from keeping the machine running the same way. Sometimes it requires throwing a wrench into it. The gears represent entrenched systems and business-as-usual politics. The wrench represents disruption — questioning assumptions, interrupting broken processes, and refusing to operate on autopilot. This shirt is a statement of independence by intention: not aligned to party machinery, but accountable to people and outcomes. Made from soft, lightweight Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, this unisex tee is designed for the realities of campaigning — breathable, comfortable, and durable through long days and longer conversations. Reinforced seams and a retail crew fit help it hold its shape, while a crisp, long-lasting print keeps the message unmistakable. Product Features • 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (lightweight, breathable) • Retail crew neck with ribbed knit collar and seam for shape retention • Side seams and shoulder tape for improved fit and long-term structure • Tear-away label; REACH certified; adult sizing; ethically produced • Durable DTF/DTG print for sharp, legible campaign graphics Care Instructions • Machine wash cold (max 30°C / 90°F) • Non-chlorine bleach as needed • Tumble dry low heat • Iron, steam, or dry at medium heat • Do not dry clean Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
